exercises.name: SkiErg
instructions: Stand facing the machine, feet hip-width, and take a handle in each hand with your arms up.
Pull the handles down past your hips, hinging at the hips and bending your knees a little as you go.
Stand back up and let your arms rise with the handles, then pull again in a steady rhythm.

exercises.name: Sled Pull
instructions: Stand behind the line facing the sled, holding the rope with both hands, knees bent and hips back.
Pull the rope hand over hand, driving through your legs and leaning back as the sled moves.
Keep pulling until the sled crosses the line, letting the slack rope gather beside you.

exercises.name: Wall Ball
instructions: Stand an arm's length from the wall holding the ball at your chest, feet shoulder-width.
Squat until your hips are below your knees, keeping your chest up.
Drive up and throw the ball to the target in one movement, then catch it and go straight into the next squat.

exercises.name: Burpee Broad Jump
instructions: Drop your chest to the floor with your hands under your shoulders.
Push up, bring your feet in under you, and jump forward with both feet as far as you can control.
Land softly with bent knees and go straight into the next burpee.

exercises.name: Sandbag Lunge
instructions: Lift the sandbag onto your shoulders behind your neck and hold it steady.
Step forward and lower your back knee until it touches the floor lightly.
Push through your front foot to stand, bring the back foot through, and lunge with the other leg.

exercises.name: Run
instructions: Run at the planned pace, outdoors or on a track.
Stay tall, land under your hips, and keep your arms relaxed.

exercises.name: Fan Bike
instructions: Set the seat on the air (fan) bike so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of each stroke.
Push and pull the handles while you pedal, using your arms and legs together.
Keep a steady effort, or sprint for the planned time.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with feet a little wider than shoulder-width, the kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge at the hips, grip the handle with both hands and hike it back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height, arms straight, then let it fall back between your legs and repeat.

exercises.name: Swim
instructions: Swim at the planned pace, any stroke, in a pool or open water.
Log the distance and the time: lengths times the pool's length give the distance.

exercises.name: Walk
instructions: Walk briskly outdoors, at a pace where you can talk but not sing.
Stand tall and let your arms swing.
